integrity: The proof uses the published all-factor upper bound as its only non-elementary premise and derives the merge gap by an exact algebraic identity. Finite random checks were used only as consistency tests and not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result compares certified decomposition lengths from one constructive family of bounds; it does not identify the exact rank of nonsingleton products.
It does not claim the direct bound is optimal among all decompositions or all specialized block bounds.
The statement is made over the complex numbers, matching the initiating theorem.
An unindexed note could contain the same elementary merge identity.
title: Direct all-factor W-state decompositions strictly beat every blockwise composition of the same bound
